units.source_text: 他和朋友走在一条巷子里。

en.t: He was walking with a friend down an alley.

units.source_text: 迎面跑过来一辆上篷的人力车。

en.t: A covered rickshaw came running toward them.

units.source_text: 而且没想到昨天的她在车上坐着。

en.t: And unexpectedly, the woman from yesterday was sitting in it.

units.source_text: 即使在白天，她的面容也宛如月下。

en.t: Even in daylight, her face seemed as if it were under the moon.

units.source_text: 在他朋友面前，他们自然没有打招呼。

en.t: In front of his friend, naturally, they did not greet each other.
